items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1962-02-10
items.q: Louie Barberin was our drummer then... Also, Louie Barberin and Narvin H. Kimball, we and myself.

ctx.x: That was the Sidney Desvinge band. Oh, yes. He was a big band.
No, Louie Barberin was our drummer then.
I was thinking trombones after Ridgely left. Do you remember who the trombones were?
